references.role: actual native-resolution 1254 integer crop to repair; no resampling

prompt: Edit the provided 1254 by 1254 native-resolution image. Return a 1254 by 1254 opaque PNG with exactly the same framing, scale, lighting, and overall drawing. This is a local repair of a hand-painted game map coastline. Preserve the existing full rounded granite boulder and cyan seawater composition. The current image has a visible erroneous vertical jagged cut through the boulder around x=530 to 780, continuing upward through the water; the boulder silhouette at about x=535,y=520 has an unnatural triangular notch. Repair these discontinuities into one smoothly rounded contiguous boulder surface: reconnect the silhouette as a broad smooth rising curve, reconcile the existing warm grey rock brush textures and shading on the two sides without a seam. Repair the nearby disconnected short water ripples so they form continuous natural ripples. Retain the already present detailed painterly brushwork and sharp native texture; do not blur, flatten, enlarge, or introduce extra rocks. Keep the original boulder positions, occupied area, outside silhouette at left/right edges, and natural texture scale. Limit meaningful changes to the interior central seam neighborhood x=360..880 and y=115..1254, tapering the drawing back into the existing surroundings before x=230 or x=1024. Preserve outer 115-pixel top, left and right bands as closely as possible; keep the bottom rock forms and lighting consistent for continuation outside the image. No UI, no people, no letters, no border. The only reference is the actual full-resolution source crop; this is a seam repair, not a new scene.
